list.title: First month in Sinchon
list.desc: A free starter map made by PinWith for Yonsei exchange students: banks, hospital, shops, cheap eats and study spots around Sinchon. Copy it, add your favourites and share with your buddy group.

items.title: Sinchon Station (신촌역, Line 2)
items.memo: Line 2 stop for Yonsei; walk up Yonsei-ro to the main gate
items.check: Google lists odd address; coordinates are Sinchon Stn

items.title: Yonsei University main gate (연세대 정문)
items.memo: Main gate at the top of Yonsei-ro, about 10 min on foot from the station

items.title: Woori Bank Yonsei branch (우리은행 연세지점)
items.memo: Bank branch on campus side; weekdays 9:00-16:00; bring passport/ARC

items.title: Severance Hospital (세브란스병원)
items.memo: International Health Care Center with English service; weekdays 8:30-17:30

items.title: Daiso Sinchon (다이소)
items.memo: Three floors of cheap household basics for your room; 10:00-22:00

items.title: Olive Young Sinchon-ro
items.memo: Toiletries and skincare by Sinchon Station; 10:00-22:30

items.title: Hyundai Department Store Sinchon
items.memo: Supermarket and food court on B1, restaurants on 10F

items.title: Homeplus Hapjeong (홈플러스)
items.memo: Large supermarket under Mecenatpolis, Hapjeong Stn; closed some Sundays

items.title: Hangyeong Hall food court (한경관)
items.memo: Campus cafeteria: set meal on 1F, buffet on 2F; weekdays only

items.title: Cochon Tonkatsu (꼬숑돈까스)
items.memo: Tonkatsu set from about ₩4,000; cash only; break 16:00-17:00

items.title: Maendorong Sikdang (맨도롱식당)
items.memo: Big bowls of pork noodle soup and rice at low prices

items.title: Potential Study Cafe Sinchon
items.memo: 24h study cafe with rentable desks and charging

items.title: Doksuri Dabang (독수리다방)
items.memo: 8th-floor cafe over Sinchon; outlets; one drink per person

items.title: Ewha Womans University (이화여대)
items.memo: Neighbouring campus; ECC building and shop streets a short walk east
